about.title: About Xianova
about.company: Xianova Robotics focuses on zero-shot generalization for robot manipulation. We propose the object-centric ORGA architecture so robots understand object structure, spatial constraints, and interaction from few demonstrations — instead of memorizing motion trajectories — and extrapolate across novel objects, scenes, and embodiments.
